claims.claim: American drive Gearbox for Ford Econoline E150 E250 E350 V8
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a car engine and transmission assembly, but make/model/variant and any readable identifiers (tag/part number) are not shown or readable.
No photo evidence of what 'toks standard' means (e.g., test results, standard spec, or condition grading).

risks.risk: Exact compatibility risk (wrong Ford Econoline year/engine/transmission variant, or different bellhousing/gearbox type).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission identification plate/label (part number/serial) and/or engine/transmission casting numbers, plus a photo of the vehicle application tag if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a potentially incompatible used gearbox/engine assembly (worst-case compatibility uncertainty).

risks.risk: Unknown running condition (may be non-functional, missing covers/fasteners, or has internal damage not visible externally).
risks.proof: Video clip of a start-up test (or at minimum a compression test result and fault-code scan if ECU is available).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: for parts/repair).

risks.risk: Missing parts / incomplete assembly (wiring/hoses look dirty and some covers/fasteners may be missing).
risks.proof: A full 360° video walkaround showing all connectors, sensors, brackets, and whether any components are absent; close-ups of any visibly missing/loose areas.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: missing small components).

risks.risk: Transmission shifting/operation not verified (external connection shown, but no evidence it shifts properly).
risks.proof: Video of gearbox operation: gear engagement sequence (P/R/N/D) or bench test results, including fluid condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as gearbox function unverified (worst-case: may not shift correctly).

risks.risk: Leak/seal/gasket condition unknown (grime may hide oil/coolant leaks; seals not inspectable from the provided angles).
risks.proof: Photos of underside and mating surfaces (bellhousing, oil pan, coolant lines) plus a leak check video after running.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potential leaks/seal wear (worst-case: needs reseal).

risks.risk: No matching identifiers (VIN/engine number) to confirm the exact unit and history.
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine number and/or VIN plate (or stamped engine/transmission numbers) for matching.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without matching certainty (worst-case: cannot confirm exact unit).

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the transmission identification plate/label (part number/serial) and any casting numbers.
Send a video of the unit running (or compression test + fault-code scan if ECU is included).
Send a full 360° video showing all sensors/connectors and confirming nothing is missing (especially around the top and transmission interface).
Provide gearbox operation proof (bench test or video showing gear engagement/shifting).
Send photos of underside/mating surfaces (bellhousing, oil pan, coolant line areas) and any evidence of leaks.
Send readable engine number and/or VIN/vehicle matching identifiers.
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s an engine/transmission assembly, but the seller’s specific Ford Econoline V8 compatibility and working condition are not verifiable from the provided observations. Missing identifiers and no running/test evidence mean pricing would be too speculative without the requested proof.
